notes.title: Thank you!
notes.content:
Just wanna say 
[h2]thanks all the players[/h2] who has invested his time playing the early demo that I released for the past Steam Next Fest.

All the feedback received is great and it will be taken on count for improving the game overall! 

[h2]Thank you!![/h2]

[h3][b]I'll take a time to fix and polish the demo based on all the feedback I received, and open a playtest  on future to ensure quality and fun in the final product, please share for support me oin this journey to give you a great new-classic metroidvania game![/b]
[/h3]

[previewyoutube=ojH34L5oA5M;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Re-playing Full Demo of Back to Home
notes.content:
Hi, I'm Jose Sanchez, solo indie developer of Back to Home!

Join to watch the demo of Back To Home a 2d metroidvania style game that I am developing completely by myself.

The main goal is to recoplie the most feedback about my game becaouse is still on developemnt and i wanto to give you a finial product with quality and fun! so that's why I ask for your help with your valuable feedback.

Feedback:
https://forms.gle/2viWibZyxetw5bca8

Thanks for your support.
